audit_scope: Incremental-to-complete PhyloTree Build 17 audit for issue 1798. 39 marker-exact nodes retain their emitted-marker and coverage locks; independent raw-row comparison classifies 27 direct motifs as exact and 12 legacy motifs as partial. All other emitted nodes have explicit pending or structural states. Completion requires every direct motif and source-topology edge to become exact.

CZ.reason: Flattened in issue 1797: Build 17 defines this structural parent of C and Z only by A249d, whose position is unrepresented in all four modern export exemplars and whose deletion allele is unsupported by the substitution-only caller. C and Z remain children of M8 so they inherit the source-backed lineage without an unscoreable 0/0 path step.

K1c.reason: Pruned from the array-reportable tree in issue 1743: its direct Build-17 motif is limited to recurrent control-region substitutions (m.146/m.152) plus m.498d, while the former emitted m.9716 belongs to K2.
